confirm.heading: Sign in to the MeetApp app on this computer?
confirm.code: Check that the app shows the same code:

done.heading: You're signed in
done.body: You can close this tab and go back to the MeetApp app.

cancelled.heading: Sign-in was cancelled
cancelled.SIGN_IN_CANCELLED: Nothing was changed. You can close this tab and try again in the MeetApp app.
cancelled.PROVIDER_EMAIL_UNVERIFIED: Your Google/Microsoft email isn't verified; create an account with your email instead.
cancelled.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again in the MeetApp app.

invalid.heading: This sign-in link isn't valid
invalid.body: It may have expired or been used already. Start again in the MeetApp app.
